title: Prohibited dog designation appeal ratified
subtitle: Council also authorized negotiating the sale of surplus city land after a closed session.
overview: Council met in a short special meeting on September 14, 2026. It ratified the Dog Designation Appeal Committee's decision to uphold a Prohibited Dog Designation. The Humane Society of Kitchener-Waterloo and Stratford Perth had applied the designation to a dog, and the owner had appealed it. Council's ratification means the designation stands {{vote:m1}}. The decision follows Corporate Services report COR-2026-354.

Council then met in closed session on a land disposition matter and a land acquisition and solicitor-client privilege matter. When it returned to open session, it passed one resolution. It authorizes the Chief Administrative Officer to negotiate the sale of a property that the city considers surplus, on terms discussed in closed session. The Chief Administrative Officer may also sign the necessary documents, to the City Solicitor's satisfaction {{vote:m3}}. The minutes do not make the terms public.
No delegations appeared, no members of Council declared a conflict of interest, and the mayor had no updates. The meeting adjourned at 6:38 p.m.

decisions.detail: Council ratified and confirmed the Dog Designation Appeal Committee's decision to uphold the Prohibited Dog Designation applied to a dog by the Humane Society of Kitchener-Waterloo and Stratford Perth.

Council authorized the Chief Administrative Officer to negotiate the sale of a surplus city property under terms discussed in closed session and to sign the documents, to the City Solicitor's satisfaction.

debate: No delegations were registered for the meeting, so Council heard no public arguments on the dog designation appeal.
The chair asked for discussion before the vote on the dog designation appeal. The transcript records none, and the motion went straight to a vote.
The transcript records no discussion of the land sale resolution either, because the substance was considered in closed session.
